hero.title: Civil Engineering (UG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A **Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** is an undergraduate program for students who wish to pursue a career in construction, infrastructure development, structural design, transportation or water resource management. The University of Mauritius has an opening for Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Civil Engineering for the academic year 2026-2027. It is a 4-year full-time course. Université des Mascareignes also has a four-year BEng program in Civil Engineering. Students planning to **Study Civil Engineering in Mauritius** can explore these undergraduate opportunities and compare the available **Civil Engineering Courses in Mauritius**.

faq.answer: University of Mauritius and Université des Mascareignes offer four year full-time BEng programs in Civil Engineering. Check the length of your chosen program and intake.

faq.question: Where to study Civil Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Civil Engineering Undergraduate Courses are available according to the official course information on University of Mauritius and Université des Mascareignes websites. faq.question: What are the eligibility criteria for Indian students?
faq.answer: Generally, students are required to have passed Class 12 or equivalent recognized qualification, with appropriate mathematics and science subjects. The minimum marks and subject requirements vary from university to university, students should check the same as per their academic board and results.

faq.question: How much does Civil Engineering cost in Mauritius in Indian Rupees?
faq.answer: The Université des Mascareignes has a non-SADC international fee category of MUR 84,000 per year, which is roughly ₹1.60 lakh at the illustrative conversion rate used here. The cost of living can be in the range of ₹4.67-₹8.89 lakh a year. Check the tuition and budget that apply before applying.

faq.question: What kind of jobs can I get after Civil Engineering?
faq.answer: They can explore civil engineering, site engineering, structural design, construction project coordination, transportation, geotechnical engineering, water resources, and CAD/BIM-related careers. Career options depend on practical skills, experience, what is required locally and any professional registration.
